appearance.identity: Silver eightfold pagoda tower with twelve occupied setback zones, corner ribs and a stepped braced crown.
appearance.exclusions: Interiors, underground works and neighboring city blocks.

brief: Compact Jin Mao exterior preserves the mapped star-shaped base, twelve occupied setbacks, horizontal courses and eight crown stages. Far levels merge corner facets and glazing; closer levels restore fins and bracing. Detailed original master stays reproducible.

sourceFacts.form: Pagoda-inspired rhythmic setbacks; stainless metal and glass facade
